package label

props {
  For      string   = ""
  Class    string   = ""
  Children gx.Node
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil

<label for={p.For} class={gx.Cx("flex items-center gap-2 text-sm leading-none font-medium select-none", p.Class)} {...p.Attrs}>{p.Children}</label>

usage:
# Label

A caption for a form control.

## Usage

```gx
<label.Label for="email">Email</label.Label>
<input id="email" name="email" type="email" />
```

## Do

- Point `For` at the id of the control.
- Keep the label short.

## Don't

- Do not use placeholder text as the only label.
- Do not point `For` at an element that is not a form control.

## Keyboard

Clicking the label moves focus to its control.
